meaning: A small item on a phone screen that shows app information without opening the app.
clues: It shows changing information on a phone screen without opening an app.
It might show the weather, news, reminders, or battery level at a glance.
You can add, move, resize, or remove it on a home screen.
Phone makers say you can pick its size when you add it.
Its name starts with W and has six letters.
assumes: An app icon is a picture you select to open an app.
A folder groups apps or files in one place.
A shortcut is a quick way to open an app or action.

decoys.meaning: A small picture on a phone screen that you select to open an app.
A place on a phone screen that groups apps or files together.
A quick link to content or an action inside an app.

exchange.text: Try it with someone you trust. Ask them to show you the screen area where you can add one, then choose a useful kind.

exchange.text: A clock on the wall gave information at a glance. This puts a little view on your phone.

exchange.speaker: bud
exchange.text: You can move it or remove it later. Try a size that is easy for you to read.
